updates.new_facts: Ethan has two personalities, the other being Elizah. He was bullied from childhood due to abnormal behavior, a native language after shifting from village to town, and poor studies. He developed Elizah as a mental twin brother who acted as his savior against bullies. He later met Zayn in class 5, fell in love with a cheating girl in class 10, met Nilanjona in college who brought his original self back, and later had Grace as a partner.
